nom: e.l.f. Cosmetics PLZ Clarify Facial Oil

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin describe the oil as absorbing quickly without leaving a greasy film, and some report reduced breakouts and clearer pores.
segments.dry: A reviewer with dry areas around cheeks and nose reported the oil made those spots drier with small white bumps before a moisturizer fixed it, while others with drier skin found it hydrating and non-stripping.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report the oil balances oily and dry zones, absorbs fast, and calms redness and congestion in the T-zone.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers generally report no irritation or breakouts, though one non-sensitive reviewer says the product still burned and one reviewer found it itchy on the whole face.
segments.mature: An older reviewer with sun-damaged, enlarged and clogged pores reports the oil smoothed and calmed bumpy, congested skin when used once daily on the T-zone.

concerns.aging: One mature reviewer with sun damage and enlarged pores reports smoother, calmer skin using it once a day in the T-zone.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it hydrates without greasiness and leaves skin soft and plump, but one reviewer reports the product dried out her skin, requiring a thicker moisturizer alongside it.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report visible reduction in redness, including nose redness and general facial redness, though one reviewer with combination skin says redness only toned down slightly and pores looked unchanged.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers describe it as adding an extra moisture barrier or feeling non-irritating and calming, with no reports of barrier damage.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report dark marks or pimple areas lightening or fading, including one with sensitive skin who uses it specifically for post-pimple darkening.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers report fewer breakouts, faster healing of active pimples, and reduced congestion; a minority report no noticeable change or, in one case, itchiness and worsening skin after weeks of use.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers, including those with oily or combination skin, say it absorbs fast and does not leave a greasy or oily residue, though a handful describe a lingering oily or heavy feel, especially right after application.

aspects.libelle: Strong or lingering herbal/tea tree scent
Greasy residue or heavy feel on skin
Dropper bottle leaking or seal issues

extraits.texte: I have combination skin, I have some areas that are dry and others that get oily. Also my nose gets really red and breaks off and on, after using this facial oil I didn't notice too much of a difference in my pores but the redness did tone down a small amount. My nose wasn't as red as usual but it was still red, luckily the product did not make me break out more than normal but I still received acne and my pores did not look any different. It absorbs pretty well without leaving a greasy texture but I wish it absorbed a little faster. This isn't really a product that I would purchase again because it didn't give me results that were very noticeable.

I am old. Years of sun damage and other factors have left me with enlarged/clogged pores. Using the Clarify Facial Oil only in my T-zone has helped smooth out and calm my bumpy red, congested skin. Using it once a day is about all my skin can handle, but I am grateful for any improvement.

extraits.titre: We keep using product enjoyed the results!
extraits.texte: This product doesn't really have a scent, its just oily I suppose. It was absorbed pretty fast on my skin and I have a mixed of oily forehead and chin and dryness around my cheeks and nose area, I definitely saw some improvement regarding my mild acne around my oily surface of my face, but I must say I also got pretty dry from it and a little white bumps they went away quickly. And the combined moisturizer cream fixed the dryness leaving my skin soft and moisturizeed with out my skin feeling sticky.

As the product description, your skin wont feel sticky or oily after applying The liquid does feel like a kind of oil but also feel like a simple serum My husband has a sensitive type so we were very careful when using this It actually work and he doesn't get break out. He has been using for 3 weeks now (2 times per week), i can see a slightly change in his big pore and the acne scars got fuller abit.

extraits.titre: A good oil to have with.
extraits.texte: The e.l.f SKIN PLZ Clarify Facial Oil is great for for dry, oily, combination, sensitive and acne prone skin. This product helps with calming visible redness in stressed skin. It work so fast, I was so impressed with the results. Now my skin is clear and feels smooth not dry or oily. It's a good product to clear your face with.

The e.l.f PLZ Clarify facial oil really works!! It clarified my clogged pores and I've noticed the redness have gone down and I have gotten less acne now! It has salicylic acid, it helps with my blackheads! The direction says uses 1-3 times a day, but I just use it before bedtime and I've noticed changes on my skin. It did dry my skin so I started using thicker moisturizer with it. I love this oil!

extraits.titre: Looks and smells nice but not quite effective for
extraits.texte: Sadly, not really a fan of this one. It didn't leave my skin feeling like it was really working and just like I was adding a green oil for no reason. Maybe I didn't use it long enough, but my skin seemed to get worse after a few weeks of use, so I quit applying this product and my skin improved some. It could be linked to stress or other life factors though, so I will have to retry this later for a full review.
